material_specs:
!- Material specifications
!- Opaque materials (massed)

  Mat_Stucco,              !- Name
  MediumRough,             !- Roughness
  0.025,                   !- Thickness {m}
  0.72,                    !- Conductivity {W/m-K}

  0.7,                     !- Solar Absorptance

  0.0125,                  !- Thickness {m}

  900,                     !- Specific Heat {J/kg-K}

  0.7,                     !- Solar Absorptance
  0.7;                     !- Visible Absorptance

  0.1,                     !- Thickness {m}

  2240,                    !- Density {kg/m3}
  900,                     !- Specific Heat {J/kg-K}
  0.9,                     !- Thermal Absorptance
  0.7,                     !- Solar Absorptance
  0.7;                     !- Visible Absorptance

  Mat_Insulation,          !- Name
  Smooth,                  !- Roughness
  2.5,                     !- Thermal Resistance {m2-K/W}

  Mat_Insulation_Floor,    !- Name
  Smooth,                  !- Roughness
  1.0,                     !- Thermal Resistance {m2-K/W}

  0.7,                     !- Solar Absorptance

  Mat_Insulation_Roof,     !- Name
  Smooth,                  !- Roughness

!- Glazing (simple)

  2.5,                     !- U-Factor {W/m2-K}

schedule_specs:
!- Schedule type limits
ScheduleTypeLimits,
  Fraction,                !- Name
  0,                       !- Lower Limit Value
  1,                       !- Upper Limit Value
  Continuous;              !- Numeric Type

ScheduleTypeLimits,
  Temperature,             !- Name
  -60,                     !- Lower Limit Value
  200,                     !- Upper Limit Value
  Continuous;              !- Numeric Type

ScheduleTypeLimits,
  ActivityLevel,           !- Name
  0,                       !- Lower Limit Value
  ,                        !- Upper Limit Value (none)
  Continuous;              !- Numeric Type

ScheduleTypeLimits,
  OnOff,                   !- Name
  0,                       !- Lower Limit Value
  1,                       !- Upper Limit Value
  Discrete;                !- Numeric Type

!- Occupancy schedule
Schedule:Compact,
  Sch_Occupancy,           !- Name
  Fraction,                !- Schedule Type Limits Name
  For: Weekdays,           !- Field 2
    Until: 09:00, 0.0,     !- Unoccupied until 9
    Until: 18:00, 1.0,     !- Occupied 9-18
    Until: 24:00, 0.0,     !- Unoccupied after 18
  For: Weekends Holidays,  !- Weekend/Holiday
    Until: 24:00, 0.0,
  For: AllOtherDays,       !- Catch-all (SummerDesignDay etc.)
    Until: 24:00, 0.0;

!- Activity level schedule (seated office work)
Schedule:Compact,
  Sch_ActivityLevel,       !- Name
  ActivityLevel,           !- Schedule Type Limits Name
  For: AllDays,            !- Constant
    Until: 24:00, 120.0;   !- 120 W/person

!- Lighting schedule (same as occupancy)
Schedule:Compact,
  Sch_Lights,              !- Name
  Fraction,                !- Schedule Type Limits Name
  For: Weekdays,
    Until: 09:00, 0.0,
    Until: 18:00, 1.0,
    Until: 24:00, 0.0,
  For: Weekends Holidays,
    Until: 24:00, 0.0,
  For: AllOtherDays,
    Until: 24:00, 0.0;

!- Heating setpoint (constant 20 C)
Schedule:Compact,
  Sch_HtgSetp,             !- Name
  Temperature,             !- Schedule Type Limits Name
  For: AllDays,
    Until: 24:00, 20.0;    !- 20°C all day

!- Cooling setpoint (constant 24 C)
Schedule:Compact,
  Sch_ClgSetp,             !- Name
  Temperature,             !- Schedule Type Limits Name
  For: AllDays,
    Until: 24:00, 24.0;    !- 24°C all day

!- HVAC availability (always on)
Schedule:Compact,
  Sch_HVAC_Avail,          !- Name
  Fraction,                !- Schedule Type Limits Name
  For: AllDays,
    Until: 24:00, 1.0;     !- 1.0 = always available
